value.message: Kids & Me at Halton Hills Public Library, Acton Branch runs Thursdays 10:30-12:00, free, for families with babies or kids up to 6 - their site says. EarlyON Child and Family Centres in Acton and Georgetown also welcome birth-to-6 with a parent, but I could not get into their page today for a day or time, so I'll keep looking and text you what it says.
